ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by dominant white (high-intensity) central zones and black (low-intensity) perimeter banding along the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches occupy the central ventral region of both lobes; dark black pixel banding follows the trailing edge; concentrated dark mottling and speckling are visible at the lower boundary of the white zones near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-depth variations of approximately 5-20 pixels; creates a jagged silhouette against the water and sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed on the trailing edge of the upright lobe, extending towards a heavily textured distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, dense clusters of circular/rosette-shaped pixel groups in tan and white tones localized at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical, dark-pixel linear rake marks are visible traversing the white pigmentation on the medial sections of the visible lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive physical accumulation of barnacle clusters at the lateral tips, significantly altering the natural geometric contour of the fluke ends.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tip of the upright lobe shows an irregular, fragmented pixel boundary beyond the barnacle clusters, suggesting minor structural degradation or amputation.
